//dependencies: Exact-pinned, no ranges. A caret range lets a compromised patch release of any dependency reach a fresh install with no review on our side. Exact pins mean the only way a new version arrives is an intentional bump here plus a regenerated package-lock.json. Install with `npm ci`, not `npm install`.
